description:
Specification: audit all RequestEffects consumers, then remove the module, reserved StateOp envelope, handler callbacks, request/PID state, native invocation binding, private snapshot sends/receives, Factory hooks and attachment-specific argument/result/checkpoint redaction. Retain independent factory budgeting/interceptor/lifecycle behavior. Do not delete generic test helpers until references are checked.
Files: lib/zaq/agent/request_effects.ex, factory.ex, stream_events.ex, tools/data_source/attach_documents.ex; test/zaq/agent/request_effects_test.exs, test/support/request_effect_probe.ex and affected selection tests.
Tests before implementation: ordinary native checkpoint/event behavior, no-tool requests, reusable runtime next turn, duplicate/cross-request/failure isolation and alias projection with actual Factory; retain observable behavior formerly exercised by generic RequestEffects tests in the appropriate owner tests.
Action reuse: remove duplicate lifecycle owner; reuse native runtime handling plus StreamEvents. No business operation or agent exposure added.
Branches: enabled/disabled attachment tool, success/error/cancel, stale/late events and runtime retirement.
Mocking: existing external LLM boundary; keep runtime real.
Docs: remove active RequestEffects references from module/service docs; preserve historical plan records.
Acceptance: no production or active-test dependencies on RequestEffects, no private mailbox transport, no broad redaction regression, no loss of lifecycle coverage. Approval from child 1 governs changed privacy expectations.

Required policies: docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/services/agent.md, docs/testing-approach.md; documentation edits additionally follow docs/documentation.md. No implementation authorized yet.
